card.name: Inside capitalized EMBRYO and WATERSHED
card.fires_on: The letters O or ED partway through all-caps words, mostly the O in EMBRY-O in boxed warning headings like EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY. Also fires in other all-caps headings such as EMBRYOLOGY and WATERSHEDS.

modes.label: EMBRYO in warnings
modes.description: The O completing EMBRYO in all-caps boxed warning titles before -FETAL TOXICITY.
modes.example: WARNING: DIARRHEA AND EMBRY<<O>>-FETAL TOXICITY Z

modes.label: Other all-caps terms
modes.description: Word endings inside all-caps headings outside drug labels, like EMBRYOLOGY or WATERSHEDS.
modes.example: WATER QUALITY IMPROVEMENT FROM MANAGEMENT PRACTICES IN AGRICULTURAL WATERSH<<ED>>S Location: Agroecos

card.plain: It lights up on the last letters of the capitalized word EMBRYO in warning headings about embryo-fetal toxicity.
